name: 37246-sonnetngram-1.7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1). One GPU, one engine.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, bf16, 1.7B params, 28 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query / 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, vocab 151936, max_position_embeddings 40960.
workload: configs/data/sonnet-128tok-100out.jsonl -- 1000 rows, columns `prompt`, `prompt_tokens_count`, `output_tokens_count`, read as guidellm `json_file`. Real sonnet text, built by configs/data/make-dataset.py from configs/data/sonnet.txt with seed 1234 at --sonnet-input-len 128 --sonnet-output-len 100 --sonnet-prefix-len 10; prompts are 112-128 tokens (mean 124.09) and every request generates exactly 100 tokens (`ignore_eos: true`). `request_format: plain` because the chat template is already rendered into the `prompt` column -- applying it again double-wraps the prompt. Sampling is temperature 1.0, repetition_penalty 1.0, engine defaults otherwise. Served in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
purpose: A poetry-writing assistant on one GPU, serving ten concurrent users short prompts with 100-token replies.
launch:
# The engine's command line, one flag per key.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B
dtype: bfloat16
tensor-parallel-size: 1
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.8
max-model-len: 32768
trust-remote-code: true
enable-prefix-caching: false
async-scheduling: true
# KEEP ON ONE LINE: the flat `key: value` reader JSON-decodes a value starting `{` and skips
# indented lines, so a nested block mapping here is dropped silently and the engine launches
# with no speculative decoding at all, at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "ngram_gpu", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "prompt_lookup_max": 2, "prompt_lookup_min": 2}
